root_cause: PDG 24 (W) mass parameter MW is nature='internal' (derived from MZ, Gf, aEW) in parameters.py; the deterministic pack writer only serializes external parameters into BLOCK MASS, so PDG 24 never gets a mass row even though DECAY 24 is present. MadEvent 3.5.3 requires a BLOCK MASS row for every DECAY-referenced particle and raises KeyError('id (24,) is not in mass') otherwise.
fix_description: The previous runtime-fix pipes 'update missing\n0\n'. The first line is rejected by the switch menu; the following 0 closes that menu, then EOF selects default 0 in the card menu and its postcmd hook runs update dependent. The numerical result is valid, but this mechanism is superseded by pi_ufo_baseline_v1_runtimefix_candidate.zip.
fallback_tooling_added: scripts/materialize_internal_masses.py: independent pure-Python re-evaluation of UFO-internal mass expressions (restricted-AST, fail-closed), used here only as a cross-check; also exposes a documented --patch fallback, unused in the primary path.
separate_issue_fixed: scripts/patch_mg5_run_card.py previously required ickkw/xqcut to be present in the MG5-generated run_card.dat, which they are not for a ZERO_JET_ONLY (unmatched) process; now REQUIRED_FIELDS={nevents,iseed,lpp1,lpp2,ebeam1,ebeam2} are enforced and OPTIONAL_FIELDS={ickkw,xqcut} are skipped when absent. Verified idempotent.
mw_cross_check_method: independent AST-restricted evaluation of Param.MW's own cmath expression against the same external MZ/Gf/aEWM1 inputs; matches MadEvent's own materialized value to rel=1e-12
